assumptions: No painted stop line is visible so a virtual stop line was placed across the carriageway at mid-distance.
Travel direction inferred as bottom-to-top from painted lane arrows pointing toward top of image and visible vehicle rears.
Line was drawn to span the full width of the car lanes from left to right.
Zone was placed on the approach side where vehicles come from, i.e. immediately south/below the line.
Top edge of zone was made coincident with the line so the zone touches the line.
Zone bottom and lateral extents were chosen to cover all car lanes over a length sufficient to observe a 1.5s wait, excluding most of the left red bike/pedestrian strip.
raw_output.line_description: stop line across all traffic lanes that cars must not cross until after waiting
raw_output.travel_direction: vehicles move from bottom to top of the image, entering the zone at its lower edge and exiting across the line at its upper edge
raw_output.zone_description: waiting area on the carriageway immediately before the stop line where cars must wait

text: Every car must wait at least 1.5 seconds in the waiting zone before it crosses the stop line.
